calls.reason: Google withheld Imagen code and public demos, while offering constrained LaMDA demos. The packet does not establish whether meaningful scientific access was systematically denied for both models.
Winoground documents weaknesses in tested models, but its human baseline uses crowdworkers. It neither establishes the five-year-old comparison nor covers all public demonstrations.

Conwell and Ullman found only about 22% of DALL-E 2 images matched basic relations; Winoground found widespread failures. Smolensky's technical account also acknowledges substantial remaining compositional limitations.
OECD reports recovering AI venture investment through 2025, and the packet establishes no qualifying AI winter. The predicted cause and exclusive remedy remain untested.

Minerva's paper describes arithmetic testing, but the packet lacks verified four-digit multiplication accuracy. Google's acknowledgment of errors does not establish the absence of an abstract multiplication concept.

SCAN experiments show substantial failures, while COGS results show robust generalization by LeAR and AM+B+dist. These mixed, restricted findings cannot settle the sweeping claim about every proposed solution.
